info.name: Global Variables (v2.1)
info.description: Demonstrates injecting global variables before a run (issue #15). The request echoes a `token` query parameter populated from a `token` global variable, and the tests assert the echoed value matches the global scope. Provide the value at the 'Global variables' prompt in Question Mode (e.g. `token=abc123`), or via Newman's `globalVar` option. Targets the public https://postman-echo.com service, so no credentials are required.

exec: pm.test('a global token was provided', function () {
pm.test('server echoes the injected global token', function () {

request.description: Echoes back the `token` query parameter, which is populated from the `token` global variable.
